messages:
alan: Quick note — onboarding pelagia-7b-int8. Low-hanging smoke shows perplexity regression vs fp16 on summarization eval after ~600 tokens, and we see rotated attention lookups getting misaligned on token boundaries when text contains ligatures/diacritics.

mina: Any quick repro commands?

alan: Repro locally: `pytest tests/onboard/test_pelagia_normalization.py::test_int8_longctx -q`
Output snippet (fp16 vs int8):
```
input text: "The officeﬁle contains résumé and co-op notes..."  # includes U+FB01 (ﬁ) ligature and U+00E9
fp16 ppl: 9.1
int8  ppl: 12.8  # large gap
```
and token streams: `fp16_ids: [12, 400, 8890, 42, 77]` vs `int8_ids: [12, 400, 8891, 42, 77]` — diverges at ligature expansion.

kyler: That smells like tokenizer normalization mismatch. Converter may have applied NFKC but tokenizer runtime didn't. Also int8 path might be using symmetric quant that assumes zero-centered embeddings; combined with token id shift you get wrong projection index.

tess: I dumped tokenizer._all_special and `tokenizer.normalize` config: converter wrote `normalize: "nfkc"` but runtime `tokenizer.normalize` returned None. Oops. Conversion command: `model-convert --from=hf --to=redwood --quant=int8 --preserve-specials` (we thought it preserved).

ci-bot: CI: onboarding/pelagia_int8_longctx 0FAILED (rougeL: fp16=0.48 int8=0.31) -- regression alert.

mina: Two things to validate quickly: (1) tokenization parity: run `python -c "from tok import Tok; print(Tok('text').encode())"` against original hf tokenizer; (2) check embedding projection order in the converted weights: we had a previous converter bug that transposed the proj matrix for int8 pack.

alan: I also dumped first 32 embedding vectors (fp16 vs int8 unpacked) using `numpy.testing.assert_allclose` and saw a column permutation on every 4th dim which aligns with our int8 block packing alignment.

kyler: Proposed fixes: (A) ensure converter writes `tokenizer_normalization` field and runtime applies normalizer on init; (B) in quant packing, use per-channel zero point quantization for final linear projections (or at least store zero points in metadata); (C) add a small smoke that tokenizes a set of unicode-edge sentences and compares ids to HF within tolerance.

tess: Implemented quick runtime patch to call `tokenizer.enable_normalization('nfkc')` when converter metadata present. Re-ran smoke: ppl dropped to 9.6 (was 12.8), rougeL improved to 0.44. Remaining delta is the proj-permute.

mina: For the permute, suggestion is to change pack layout to keep original col-major order and add a loader shim that reorders blocks for the int8 kernel. We should also add a converter assertion: `assert np.allclose(unpacked_fp16[:, :8], unpacked_int8[:, :8], atol=1e-2)` to catch obvious misorders.

alan: I'll open a small PR with converter metadata fix + loader shim + unicode tokenization regression tests. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/conv/pulls/1468

ci-bot: PR 1468: presubmit queued (onboard smoke, int8-bench).

kyler: Also doc note for onboarding checklist: "Always run unicode_edgecases.txt tokenization parity check and embedding-proj parity check under quant modes." Add to onboarding playbook.

alan: Thanks — will update playbook and close after CI passes.
